reels.caption:
After more than a century of work, Barcelona's iconic Sagrada Família basilica has now reached its maximum height of 172.5 meters with the placement of the final cross atop the central Tower of Jesus Christ, a major milestone in its long construction journey.

Despite this achievement, the basilica remains officially unfinished, with further work still underway even as it stands as the tallest church in the world.

Designed by Antoni Gaudí and under construction since 1882, the Sagrada Família has become one of the most extraordinary architectural landmarks globally, symbolizing creative ambition and enduring vision.

Source: AP News

Credits by: @basilicasagradafamilia

reels.caption:
Thunderstorms always make me slow down and savor every cozy moment. ⛈️🌲

Which storm-related visual do you find most soothing? answer in my poll attached — i think definitely all of them! but I particularly love watching raindrops sliding down the windows. I find it so mesmerizing! 🌧️🪟

this day in particular: the rain was pounding against the windows hard, thunder was booming mingling with the gentle hum of a Aretha Franklin vinyl softly playing on my record player, and the electricity flickering on and off causing the glow of the lit candles and fairy lights briefly cast the room in a soft, golden light. 🕯️🪟✨

I was wrapped in a thick blanket with a hot drink in hand, losing myself in a puzzle on the dining table and eventually settling in on my couch for a spooky movie, the storm outside adding the perfect eerie touch. ⛈️

thunderstorms and gloomy weather prompt me to take a deep breath and find solace in small comforts—the warmth of my coziest socks, the soothing rhythm of the rain, the soft glow of my candle warmer lamp, and the aroma of my cozy drink. I savor the gentle patter of rain on the window, the rustle of pages in a book, the comforting weight of my blanket, and the quiet hum of household appliances. Each detail enhances the serene, introspective atmosphere, making it a perfect time for relaxation and reflection. 💭⛈️
